summary: Expanded the public-power/grid-hardening node with a deliberately underfollowed lens. Reference anchors such as GE Vernova and Quanta Services remain useful cycle indicators, but this pass prioritizes narrower equipment, components, coatings, and contractor names tied to utility capex, transmission/distribution buildout, storm hardening, wildfire mitigation, and electrical infrastructure lead-time pressure. The strongest underfollowed candidates found in this pass are Powell Industries for switchgear/electrical distribution systems, Preformed Line Products for line hardware and utility inspection services, MYR Group for transmission/distribution contracting capacity, and AZZ for galvanizing/coatings used in transmission, distribution, and infrastructure steel.
